key_highlights: ASX closed the week lower as traders positioned for a potential RBA rate hike, with Greg Jericho questioning whether the RBA should raise rates given a stalling economy
Aussie banks forecast the biggest house price falls on record; CBA reports home loan applications down 15% since the federal budget
Iron ore sector faces a structural shakeout masked by geopolitical conflict; Macarthur clears WA bulk test hurdle
Bathla construction collapse signals broader stress in Australia's construction and housing supply pipeline
EV sales overtook petrol cars for the first time in Australia amid soaring fuel costs
Small-cap miners (Kaoko, Vanadium Resources, Piche, Aurum, Brightstar, Solstice, Power Minerals) led ASX runners
ASIC launched a review of whistleblower complaints at Big Four accounting firms
Victoria's soaring debt drew warnings from ratings agencies
Global AI/tech momentum continues (Nvidia, Oura IPO, Adobe leadership change) but energy transition costs are mounting

sectors.trend: Under pressure from record house-price fall forecasts, 15% drop in home loan applications, and CBA/Westpac loyalty-fee scrutiny. Credit cycle turning.
sectors.implications: NIM compression risk as loan growth stalls; NPLs may rise. CBA.AX, WBC.AX, ANZ.AX, NAB.AX face margin headwinds. Defensive dividend yields remain attractive but capital returns may be constrained.

sectors.trend: Iron ore shakeout underway amid geopolitical conflict; small-cap explorers (Kaoko, Vanadium, Piche, Aurum, Brightstar, Solstice, Power Minerals) outperforming. Macarthur clears WA bulk test.
sectors.implications: BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX face structural demand risk from iron ore shakeout. Gold (Aurum) and critical minerals (vanadium, lithium) offer diversification. Small-caps carry high volatility.

sectors.trend: TMK Energy gas rates surge on Mongolian drilling; Beetaloo gas cartel concerns; energy transition costs mounting; oil majors reluctant to build US refineries.
sectors.implications: Santos.AX, Woodside.AX, AGL.AX, Origin.AX face policy and cost uncertainty. TMK Energy (TMK.AX) benefits from gas rate tailwinds. Transition-cost risk weighs on utilities.

sectors.trend: Bathla collapse signals systemic construction stress; housing construction to follow prices lower; Melbourne councils admit infrastructure cannot cope with population growth.
sectors.implications: REITs (GPW.AX, SPG.AX, ICPS.AX) face occupancy and capex risk. Construction names (WTC.AX, MDS.AX) under pressure. Housing downturn is a multi-year drag on GDP.

sectors.trend: EV sales overtook petrol cars for first time; hidden costs (charging, grid) emerging; Volkswagen cutting 50,000 jobs globally.
sectors.implications: WES.AX, WOW.AX benefit from fuel-cost savings shifting to discretionary spend. EV supply-chain names gain. Global auto weakness (VW) is a cautionary signal.

sectors.trend: Global AI boom continues (Nvidia, Oura IPO, Adobe); Ozempic maker in trouble; Cardinal Health flagged as attractive.
sectors.implications: CSL.AX, SXW.AX benefit from global pharma/healthcare demand. ASX tech exposure limited but AI infrastructure spend supports capex cycles. Ozempic disruption may shift GLP-1 market dynamics.

Iron ore structural shakeout masked by geopolitical noise
Construction sector fragility (Bathla) as a macro warning sign
EV adoption inflection point in Australia
Small-cap mining and critical minerals outperformance
ASIC regulatory scrutiny of Big Four accountants
Global AI capex super-cycle vs. energy transition cost overruns
Canada outperforming Australia on per-capita growth

risk_assessment.risk_factor: RBA rate hike in a stalling economy
risk_assessment.mitigation: Monitor RBA statement language; favour rate-sensitive defensives (staples, healthcare) over cyclicals; hedge with gold.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Housing credit contraction and construction defaults
risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce exposure to construction and property-linked names; favour banks with strong NPL provisions; watch CBA loan pipeline data.
Diversify away from pure iron ore (BHP, RIO, FMG) toward gold, copper, and critical minerals; monitor Chinese steel data.
Watch ratings agency downgrades; avoid VIC-domiciled REITs and infrastructure bonds until clarity.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Energy transition cost overruns and gas supply risk
risk_assessment.mitigation: Favour integrated energy majors with hedged portfolios; monitor Beetaloo and TMK developments.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: ASIC regulatory action on Big Four / corporate governance
risk_assessment.mitigation: Monitor ASIC announcements; ensure portfolio companies have robust audit and whistleblower frameworks.

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight gold and critical-minerals explorers as a hedge against rate uncertainty and iron ore weakness
opportunities.rationale: Aurum adding high-grade ounces; Kaoko, Vanadium, Piche leading ASX runners; gold benefits from rate-hike fears and geopolitical risk

opportunities.recommendation: Add defensive healthcare and consumer staples exposure
opportunities.rationale: CSL and WES offer resilience in a stalling economy; Ozempic disruption creates GLP-1 tablet opportunity; EV shift supports discretionary spend

opportunities.recommendation: Selective energy exposure via gas-rate beneficiaries
opportunities.rationale: TMK Energy gas rates surging on Mongolian drilling; Beetaloo gas cartel dynamics create pricing tailwinds for independent producers

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce or hedge pure iron ore and construction exposure
defensive_moves.rationale: Iron ore shakeout structural; Bathla collapse signals construction sector fragility; housing construction to follow prices lower

defensive_moves.recommendation: Trim bank exposure pending credit-cycle data; favour highest-quality capital positions
defensive_moves.rationale: 15% loan application drop and record house-price fall forecasts signal rising NPL risk; CBA/Westpac fee scrutiny adds reputational risk

defensive_moves.recommendation: Maintain cash or short-duration bonds as RBA rate-hike risk persists
defensive_moves.rationale: ASX closed lower on rate fears; economy stalling; rate hike would pressure equities further

market_outlook.short_term: Cautiously bearish. ASX likely to consolidate lower as RBA rate-hike risk dominates. Housing credit data and iron ore pricing will be key swing factors. Small-cap miners and gold provide relative outperformance. Expect volatility around RBA communications.
market_outlook.long_term: Neutral-to-cautious. Structural iron ore demand shift, housing cycle downturn, and energy transition cost overruns weigh on growth. However, AI capex super-cycle, critical minerals demand, and EV adoption provide offsetting tailwinds. Australia's per-capita growth lagging Canada is a concern. 6–12 month outlook hinges on RBA policy path and Chinese demand.
